usedFor: Shopify holds checkouts and orders, and telecrm receives a lead through “Create Lead”, matched by phone number.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Lead” in telecrm
bestTemplate.why: A checkout with an email or phone becomes a lead, or updates one that exists.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so “Create Lead” runs after a scheduled check.
